takeaways: The 29.4-point margin was larger than either team's main lineup leak, so the matchup was decided more by raw scoring than one obvious swap.
The clearest unit edge was total WR output: Reverse Ted Lasso by 16.8 points.
Against projection, Reverse Ted Lasso finished +26.3 while Two Buck Luck finished +7.7.
The biggest started performance was Josh Jacobs for Reverse Ted Lasso at 36.7 points.
